🌟 OpenDocs | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated generation of diverse documentation formats from source files like READMEs, Markdown, and Jupyter Notebooks.
✨ Key Features: • Converts READMEs, Markdown, and Jupyter Notebooks • Generates multiple output formats (.docx, .pptx, .pdf, .md, .json, .tex, .html) • Creates technical reports, executive decks, blog posts, Jira tickets, academic papers, social cards, FAQs, analysis reports, and more
📖 Summary: OpenDocs is a Python tool that automatically converts GitHub READMEs, Markdown files, and Jupyter Notebooks into a variety of professional documentation formats. It leverages AI to generate outputs like technical reports, executive decks, PDFs, blog posts, Jira tickets, academic papers, and even interactive knowledge graphs.
